Coverage Focuses on Sawan First Monday Rituals and Recipes

Multiple Indian media outlets provided coverage centered on the first Monday of the Sawan month. The reports offered guidance on religious observances, including auspicious timings, puja rituals, and items to offer to Lord Shiva. Additionally, several recipes for fasting-appropriate dishes were shared, such as makhana barfi, tomato-peanut kadhi, sabudana halwa, and peanut barfi, often emphasizing preparation without onion or garlic.
